prompt: Estimate yearly US hospital spending on hand-sanitizer refills.

steps.label: Pick the drivers that build the estimate
Multiply them out: your estimate of the total

options.text: Staffed hospital beds in the US
options.feedback: A driver: Reasoning: about 6,000 hospitals × about 150 staffed beds on average ≈ 900,000
A driver: Reasoning: at the bedside, the door and in hallways

model_answer: 920k (staffed hospital beds in the US) × 3 (sanitizer dispensers per bed) × 25 (refills per dispenser per year) × 12 (average price per refill) ≈ $828M
explanation: 920k (staffed hospital beds in the US) × 3 (sanitizer dispensers per bed) × 25 (refills per dispenser per year) × 12 (average price per refill) ≈ $828M.
